dedupe_keys.name: eurovent certified product directory hvac and heat pump performance data

description: The Certified Product Directory of Eurovent Certita Certification is an online database of HVAC and refrigeration products certified by the body, which the provider describes as one of the largest of its kind, with performance data for over 40 certification programmes across five schemes: Eurovent Certified Performance, NF, QB, KEYMARK and MCS. Heat pump data are split over five programmes: Eurovent-HP for electrically driven, gas absorption and engine-driven heat pumps; LCP-HP for hydronic chillers and heat pumps; NF414 heat pumps; Heat Pump KEYMARK for electric, hybrid and combination heat pumps and hot water heaters; and MCS007 for UK heat pumps up to 45 kW. Certification involves independent laboratory tests, factory audits, software checks and surveillance, and users can view, filter and download product data and certificates. Coverage: products certified for European markets. Access: free online directory from the Eurovent Certification site. Licence: provider terms. Caveats: only products whose manufacturers joined a programme appear, and scheme requirements differ. Simulation uses: rated capacities and efficiencies for heat pump and HVAC equipment in building energy models. Related records: the NEEP cold climate heat pump list and ENERGY STAR certified products data.
